message.content:
The most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at **about 0.41–0.42**.  
- **OECD** (latest available data) reports a Gini of **0.411** for the U.S. (2021).  
- **World Bank** lists a Gini of **0.421** (2019).

These figures reflect income inequality measured on a scale from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (maximum inequality). The exact value can differ slightly depending on the methodology and the year of the data.
